verdict.rationale: GitHub's own messaging says you can "Extend your stack with apps, actions, and AI models," and the Marketplace apps listing shows many real third-party integrations (Render, Lovable, Atlassian/Jira, Slack, Shopify, mobile CI/CD). Actions and multiple AI models are documented as platform features, but the evidence does not show them being browsed or installed from the marketplace. missing for 10: evidence of a marketplace for third-party Actions, evidence of a marketplace or catalog for AI models (only Copilot's built-in model selection is shown), independent or hands-on corroboration of marketplace installs.
